messages:
Sam: Quick note 3 splitting billing into fast-path (provisional) + audit-path. Posting short Qs before RFC.

Rhea: Sounds good. Fast-path for UX, audit for bookkeeping?

Sam: Exactly. Fast has claim_id, tenant_id, token_delta. Audit has full provenance, tokenizer_version, model, prompt_hash.

Tom: Server-side fanout at ingress? avoid double-client sends?

Sam: Yes, single ingest then fanout to provisional topic (short TTL) and audit topic (long TTL).

Priya: Key: claim_id for dedupe/finality and event fingerprint for reconciler. Provisional must be revocable.

Tom: Reconciler should emit compensating events if audit disagrees. We need API to fetch claim status.

Rhea: Retention defaults: provisional 24h, audit 90d. Tenant overrides supported. Encryption for audit topic.

ingest-bot: Fanout canary: provisional 0.4ms median, audit append 10ms median.

Sam: Next: I'll draft RFC. Priya will sketch reconciler. Sync Mon 11?

Priya: works for me.

Tom: +1
